prompt: Design a shared task service. Some customers are regulated; traffic and isolation requirements are unspecified.

assertions.text: Ask a bounded batch about materially different requirements.
Do not produce implementation tasks.
State assumptions and compare viable alternatives.

prompt: Plan this approved greenfield collaboration product. GitHub Projects is authoritative; identity, core collaboration and enterprise controls are sequential milestones.

assertions.text: Load the actual GitHub hierarchy from project context before publishing.
Fully elaborate only identity.
Future milestones each contain one planning task and no implementation phases.
Return a loadable Plan Context referencing authoritative work items.

prompt: Implement only the supplied validation task; an unrelated working-tree change already exists.

assertions.text: Preserve unrelated edits.
Verify the requested behavior.
Do not commit unless authorized.

prompt: Why does this request fail? Inspect the provided failing trace. Do not fix it.

assertions.text: Return findings inline.
Distinguish evidence from inference.
Offer Markdown and Pitch Deck options.
Do not change application code.

prompt: Review this pull request and create a Markdown report only.

assertions.text: Return an inline verdict and severity-ranked findings.
Create the requested report from the same findings.
Do not post to GitHub or create an HTML report.

prompt: Present this investigation to engineers. No performance measurements were collected.

assertions.text: Lead with the investigation outcome.
Do not invent metrics.
Create a self-contained accessible HTML deck.
Use meaningful visuals and verify navigation.

prompt: Plan a week in Japan for two travelers; one has food allergies, but dates and budget are missing.

assertions.text: Gather consequential constraints.
Research current options with sources.
Distinguish proposed options from booked travel.

prompt: Turn this approved itinerary into HTML; two hotels remain undecided.

assertions.text: Preserve unresolved hotel choices.
Include accessible navigation and theme controls.
Do not make bookings or silently replan.

prompt: Suggest a morning playlist. Do not change my music account.

assertions.text: Explain ordering and listening concept.
Respect exclusions.
Do not mutate the music account.
